hypothesis: Learn when competing foreground correspondence is trustworthy instead of treating every high raw vote as calibrated identity evidence. Measure a cue's signed increment relative to preserved RGB ownership.
input_version: Existing November DiffV2IR, never regenerated or replaced
source_sampling: Uniform integer frames from1 through sequence length minus8, all six frozen Train videos
perturbation: Independent centre displacement in box-size units and log-size noise; keep positive image-clipped boxes
labels: Train-only IoU0.5 Hungarian assignment to fish GT, then equality of valid source/target identity; unknown source queries excluded
preserved_RGB_inputs: 23 pair features: box geometry, RGB appearance/shape/colour, RGB contrast, RGB point ownership and row/column competition
cue_inputs: 17 matched pair features: two cue crop/shape similarities, contrast qualities, both ends of point ownership and surviving-point coverage
cue_reference: RGB source/target foreground ownership; RGB mask crop and RGB HOG
RGB_capacity_control: Bounding-box point ownership and unmasked RGB appearance as a second RGB view; no IR arrays or IR quality
IR_cue: Joint RGB/actual-new-IR foreground ownership and existing new-IR-guided crop/shape evidence
formula: logit(P_RGB_point) + 4*tanh((f(base,cue)-f(base,RGB_reference))/4). Shared f cancels any cue-independent offset; zero last layer exactly preserves the RGB point probability. Unsupported IR gives zero increment.
ordinary_components: MLP, binary cross entropy, point optical flow and normalization receive no novelty credit by themselves
lr_schedule: Cosine from0.001 to0.0001 over36, unchanged across resume
sampling: Uniform Train video; sample its pair rows with replacement; no class reweighting
normalization: Train-only feature means/std, floor0.05; no batch context
loss: Pairwise binary cross entropy with raw RGB point log-odds offset, bounded signed cue increment and0.001 increment-square regularization
selection: Complete Dev HOTA only. No Test score selects a threshold, a feature, an epoch or a checkpoint.
stopping: At common epoch18 and subsequent six-epoch checks, extend all six paired RGB/IR fits together if any best Dev HOTA improves by more than0.2pp over best through12 epochs earlier; otherwise stop, cap36. Earliest checkpoint wins ties.
resources: Only physical GPUs2/3 for frozen appearance extraction and fitting; bounded current/past image buffers; compact pair features outside Git
interpretation: A proposed conditional multimodal calibration, not a validated innovation. Original >=+5 Test HOTA target and2-3 independently positive contributions remain unchanged.
